running_thesis: The Nasdaq-100 closed 19 Nov at 26517.05 (-2.21%) after a sell-the-news reversal on the Anthropic IPO debut (Cboe). All three indices are down more than 3% in November. VIX 28.44, VXN 36.48, COR1M 30.22 (+30.03%): the selling broadened beyond tech. The 9 Dec hike is effectively priced (Polymarket 25 bps 92.5%, 50+ bps 3.8%), yet yields fell on the day (10-year 5.04%). AMD fell 7.7% on short-seller allegations it denies; Nvidia probe and succession overhangs persist. HY OAS 3.47 as of 18 Nov. Oil data stale to 17 Nov.
open_questions: Is Friday the final leg of the November washout or does the AI unwind continue?
Does COR1M above 30 signal contagion beyond tech?
Do AMD export and circular-financing allegations spread to other chipmakers?
Do 50+ bps hike odds rise again before 9 Dec?
